newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-WIDZEW RETAIN TITLE WITH THREE LATE GOALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WIDZEW RETAIN TITLE WITH THREE LATE GOALS.

text.p: Widzew Lodz fired three goals in the last five minutes for a dramatic 3-2 win over Legia Warszawa to retain the Polish league title on Wednesday.
Second-placed Legia were leading through goals from Cezary Kucharski in the 11th minute and Sylwester Czereszewski in the 57th before Widzew transformed the match with their late onslaught.
In the 88th miniute Slawomir Majak scored Widzew's first goal, then Dariusz Gesior hit the equaliser three minutes later.
Andrej Mikhalchuk scored the winner in the third minute of injury time.
Widzew are now four points ahead of Legia with one regular-season game remaining for each team.
